name: Cartridges: the context compiler
one_line: Compile a static corpus into a trained, portable compact-KV artifact that loads into stock vLLM as a prefix; the systems half is built and tested, the quality half is unproven (one negative 360M/CPU attempt), so the plan is a two-week pre-registered GPU experiment, then a four-week build on what survives.
